articles.title: ‘Armed Naxals gone, but ideological Naxals seek opportunities’: PM Modi urges ‘Identify & Isolate’
articles.description: From the Red Fort on India’s 80th Independence Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi warned against what he called ‘intellectual Naxals’ (Dimagi Naxals), saying the armed insurgency may be declining but its ideological challenge remains. He alleged that people with a Maoist mindset had influenced government committees and public policy, urging citizens to ‘identify and isolate’ them. Modi also recalled the human cost of decades of Naxal violence, hailed progress in ending insurgency and called on young Indians to contribute to a ‘Nasha Mukt Bharat’.

articles.title: In 1871, pack ice trapped and crushed 33 American whaling ships off Alaska; 144 years later, NOAA archaeologists found confirmed wreckage in the Chukchi Sea
articles.description: Archaeologists have made an astonishing find: the wreckage of the 1871 whaling fleet buried in Arctic waters. The fleet, claimed by ice, left more than 1,200 individuals abandoned in the wilderness. With melting ice creating new pathways, previously unreachable underwater areas have come to light. Utilizing sonar and magnetic sensors, experts have located ship remains and artifacts, shedding light on a crucial chapter in maritime history.

articles.title: In 2012, researchers began collecting dragonfly larvae to reveal mercury pollution in protected waters. 13 years later, 21,000 samples helped create a model that can estimate freshwater mercury risk without testing every waterway

The model can guide future testing and inform fish consumption advisories for communities.
